definitions.gloss: backing; sponsorship; personal initiative (of an influential person)
definitions.explanation: The active support or arrangement of someone influential who sets up and promotes a project, as in {首相|しゅしょう}の{肝|きも}いりで (at the prime minister's initiative). In news language, a 〜{肝|きも}いりの{政策|せいさく} is a policy someone has personally championed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肝|きも}いり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{新事業|しんじぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The new business was launched at the president's personal initiative.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{知事|ちじ}→知事：03467_chiji⟧{肝|きも}いり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧だ。
examples.english: This is a plan the governor has personally championed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧{肝|きも}いり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧{不足|ぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ような⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上|あ}がらなかった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: It was the prime minister's pet policy, but for lack of funds it did not produce the results hoped for.

notes:
Also written {肝煎|きもい}り. The word suggests that the backer's prestige is at stake, so news reports often use it when such a project struggles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肝|きも}いり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at the initiative of, with the backing of
- 〜{肝|きも}いり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ / ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧: a policy / project championed by ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後援|こうえん}→後援：12616_kouen⟧: support, sponsorship — formal backing, not necessarily personal
- {鳴|な}り{物入|ものい}り: with great fanfare
